beats.event: A famous wrestler and leader in Umuofia
Built his wealth to escape the shadow of his indolent father
Rules his household with beatings; obsessed with manliness
Elders make him guardian of the boy Ikemefuna
Ikemefuna comes to see him as a second father
Oracle decrees the boy must die; he strikes the blow himself
Haunted by nightmares after killing Ikemefuna
His gun bursts at a funeral, killing Ezeudu's son
Exiled with his family for seven years to Mbanta
Hears in exile that White men are bringing Christianity
His son Nwoye leaves the family for the missionaries
Returns to find Umuofia transformed by the White men
Village burns a church after a convert unmasks an elder
District Commissioner jails the leaders, demands a heavy fine
Court messengers humiliate the imprisoned men
Calls a meeting to decide how to answer the foreigners
Beheads the head messenger who tries to stop the meeting
Realizing the village won't fight, he hangs himself
